title: Nifty faces key 23,200 hurdle, analysts remain cautious
summary: Nifty has recently surged by nearly 2%, approaching the resistance level at 23,200. Analysts recommend building long positions to capitalize on a potential breakout. Support is set between 22,600 and 22,800, serving as a buffer. Recommended stocks for investment this week include DLF and Zensar Technologies. Investors should exercise caution in the broader market until significant resistance levels are broken.

title: Air India weighs Singapore Airlines executive for CFO as losses mount
summary: Air India's management has held preliminary discussions on the appointment with Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran and Air India chief executive officer (CEO) Tewolde Gebremariam, both of whom are understood to be supportive of the move.
